fusions.name: Gallop-By Grab
fusions.desc: Gallops up to 7 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Ground Under Hoof
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: deals 20 damage plus 1.3 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have travelled (max +30%).

fusions.name: Bareback Bolt
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 50% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Heart

riders.text: the ground goes by at a gallop
and you are gone before the hand closes
and your hands keep the hoofbeats' time

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1.
